Runs a slave interrupt loopback test on the I3c device and driver.

detaileddescription.para: This function does a slave interrupt loopback test on the I3c device and driver as a design example. The purpose of this function is to illustrate how to use the XI3cPsx driver in slave interrupt mode.
This function sends data from the master and receives it on the slave through the I3C loopback. It expects the controllers to be in loopback.
This function uses interrupt-driven slave mode and polled master mode of the I3C.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the device.

simplesect.para: In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Updates transfer status on events from the I3cPsx.

detaileddescription.para: This function is the handler which updates transfer status upon events from the I3cPsx. It is called from an interrupt context such that the amount of processing performed should be minimized.

parameterdescription.para: The status event from the I3cPsx.

briefdescription.para: Runs the I3C slave interrupt loopback example.

detaileddescription.para: Main function to call the slave interrupt loopback example.
This file consists of a slave mode design example which uses the Xilinx I3C device in slave interrupt mode in a loopback setup.
The master sends data to the slave. The slave receives the data using interrupt-driven mode. The received data is then verified against the transmitted data. Slave also sends the data to master.
This code assumes that no Operating System is being used.
It's a reference example and the data size should be less than or equal to FIFO size.
